{{Quote|I heartily recommend the Tenbah Squid Pie with Roosha topping.|M-3PO|<ref name="FC" />}}
'''Tenbah Squid Pie''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|seafood]] [[Pie/Legends|pie]] that was served with [[Roosha topping]]. The [[Squid/Legends|squid]] dish was [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] at the [[Farrimmer Cafe]] at the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Mynock 7 Space Station]], where the [[Service droid/Legends|waiter droid]] [[M-3PO (Treedee)|M-3PO]] once recommended it to a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].<ref name="FC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tenbah Squid Pie was mentioned in "[[The Farrimmer Cafe]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] article written by [[Jean Rabe]] and [[J. Allan Fawcett]] and published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|eleventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' in [[November]] [[1996]].<ref name="FC" />
